title: The Portrait of Saint Alder's Again
author: Casper Sterling
blurb: Oscar Dravenmoor, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
